title: feat(traces): call-path tree in the waterfall

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge 1 warning −1 · tests partial −1 Rewrites the trace Waterfall body as a call-path tree: `flattenTree` now returns `TreeRow`s carrying ancestor rails, and rows draw rails, elbows and a stem, a status square on leaves, dimmed `Receiver.method` names, `file:line` labels and a service label only where the service changes. Behaviour matches the description and the immutable `SpanNodeData` tree is walked correctly; the only gap is that the new rail geometry is untested. ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · New flattenTree rail and level geometry has no test tests · [`apps/web/src/page/traces/detail/waterfall/tree.ts:26-32`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/539ade7cb948e1d1f0e412a62bfa0f382e89b6f6/apps/web/src/page/traces/detail/waterfall/tree.ts#L26-L32) `rails`, `isLast` and `treeLevel` decide every rail and elbow the tree draws, and nothing in `waterfall.scene.test.ts` pins them: an off-by-one in `[...rails, !isLast]` or in `rails.length + 1` misaligns the whole tree while the existing scene tests stay green. Add a test over a root with two expanded children and one grandchild asserting the `rails`, `isLast` and `treeLevel` of each row. ``` Add a `tree.test.ts` (or a case in `waterfall.scene.test.ts`) that flattens a root with two expanded children and one grandchild, and asserts per row: `rails` (`[true]` for the grandchild of the first child, `[false]` under the last child), `isLast`, and `treeLevel`. ```
`539ade7` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.
